test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If Al is 19 times more than A2, then A2 is what percentage less than A1?
solution:
**Given:**

A1 = 19 × A2

**Formula Used:**

Percentage decrease = ((Original value - New value) / Original value) × 100

**Calculation:**

Original value (A1) = 19 × A2

New value (A2) = A2

Percentage decrease = ((19 × A2 - A2) / (19 × A2)) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease = ((19A2 - A2) / 19A2) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease = (18A2 / 19A2) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease = (18 / 19) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease ≈ 94.74%

**The percentage decrease is approximately 95 percent.**
